# Reusable workflows reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-workflow-reference.sh: do not edit by hand. -->

Neither workflow exposes outputs: the result is the job status. On GitHub,
zizmor also uploads SARIF results to Code Scanning.

## `validate-helm.yml`

| Input | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chart-path` | string | true | `` | Path to the Helm chart to validate |
| `helm-version` | string | false | `v3.16.3` | Helm version to use for validation (default: v3.16.3) |
| `kubeconform-version` | string | false | `0.8.0` | kubeconform version to use for validation (default: 0.8.0) |
| `kubeconform-kubernetes-version` | string | false | `1.31.0` | Kubernetes version to use for kubeconform validation (default: 1.31.0) |
| `kube-linter-version` | string | false | `0.8.3` | kube-linter version to use for validation (default: 0.8.3) |
| `conftest-version` | string | false | `0.69.0` | conftest version to use for validation (default: 0.69.0) |

## `zizmor.yml`

| Input | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | string | false | `` | Space-separated workflow files to scan. Empty (default): every *.yml/*.yaml under .github/workflows and .gitea/workflows.  |
